readings: For each trader.tradekind value, how many distinct transactionrecord records have at least one linked advancedbehavior record, with both the transaction and its trader found? What is each count divided by the total number of such distinct transactions across all trader.tradekind values? Do not round the share; include NULL as a group if present.

For each trader.tradekind value, how many advancedbehavior records link to a transactionrecord record whose trader is found? Count each advancedbehavior record separately, even when several link to the same transaction. What is each count divided by the total number of such advancedbehavior records across all trader.tradekind values? Do not round the share; include NULL as a group if present.
queries:
WITH eligible_transactions AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT tr.transreg, t.tradekind
    FROM transactionrecord AS tr
    JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref
    JOIN advancedbehavior AS ab ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
),
counts AS (
    SELECT tradekind, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
    FROM eligible_transactions
    GROUP BY tradekind
)
SELECT
    tradekind,
    transaction_count,
    1.0 * transaction_count / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS share
FROM counts

SELECT
    t.tradekind,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count,
    COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share
FROM advancedbehavior AS a
JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = a.translink
JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref
GROUP BY t.tradekind
